## 2. Technical Stack Breakdown

### Primary Languages
1. **TypeScript / JavaScript**: Primary production language for end-to-end full-stack web applications.
2. **Go (Golang)**: Chosen for high-throughput microservices, concurrent worker pipelines, and real-time backend systems.
3. **SQL (PostgreSQL)**: Complex relational modeling, ACID transactions, Prisma ORM, Neon, query optimization.
4. **Python**: Machine learning models, FinBERT NLP analysis, FastAPI microservices, automated scripts.

### Frontend Engineering
- Next.js 15 & 16 (App Router, Server Components, Streaming SSR, dynamic Metadata API)
- React 19 (Component-driven architecture, custom hooks, transition management)
- Tailwind CSS & Vanilla CSS Modules for bespoke motion and typography
- GSAP & ScrollTrigger for high-performance 60fps animations
- Three.js / React Three Fiber for interactive 3D web elements
- TanStack Query (React Query) & Zustand for client state management

### Backend Engineering & Infrastructure
- Node.js & Express.js for RESTful and event-driven microservices
- WebSockets (Socket.io) and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for live streaming data
- WebRTC for peer-to-peer and SFU video/audio collaboration
- Redis & Upstash Redis for caching hot queries, session presence, rate limiting, and message pub/sub
- Docker & Docker Compose for containerized local and staging environments
- Kubernetes fundamentals for container orchestration
- PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, MongoDB, Mongoose
- CI/CD via GitHub Actions and cloud deployment on Render, Vercel, and AWS

### AI Product Engineering
- LLM Token Streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- Multi-provider AI orchestration with OpenRouter
- Embedding models, vector stores, and prompt engineering
- Financial sentiment intelligence with FinBERT

## 3. Work Experience

### Backend Developer Intern — Weya.ai (March 2026 – May 2026)
- Designed and built a 3-tier audit logging middleware with four distinct operational modes (skip, generic, summary, rich) across 30+ classified API endpoints.
- Implemented non-blocking asynchronous database writes into PostgreSQL utilizing Prisma atomic transactions, ensuring zero latency penalty on critical user paths.
- Spearheaded the logging subsystem migration from MongoDB to PostgreSQL, establishing schema integrity and relational audit trails.
- Built multi-tenant tracking capabilities to capture and log superadmin operations on the Nexus AI voice calling platform.

## 4. In-Depth Project Catalog

### Project 1: Kanbex
- **Domain**: SaaS Project Management & Real-Time Collaboration
- **Live URL**: https://kanbex-frontend.onrender.com/
- **Description**: A distributed Kanban platform built to eliminate lag and multi-user sync conflict.
- **Engineering Highlights**:
  - Drag-and-drop board interface with optimistic UI reconciliation.
  - Multi-client WebSocket synchronization for real-time card moves and comments.
  - Redis cache layer for rapid workspace retrieval and atomic board updates.
  - Containerized production build with Docker and continuous deployment via GitHub Actions.

### Project 2: Wizardry AI
- **Domain**: AI SaaS & Visual Content Generation
- **Live URL**: https://wizardryai.onrender.com/
- **Description**: An AI SaaS application offering interactive prompt generation, visual workflows, and document generation.
- **Engineering Highlights**:
  - Resilient token streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE).
  - Visual editor with document version history, rollbacks, and branching.
  - Stripe integration for tiered subscriptions, payment webhooks, and quota enforcement.

### Project 3: CodeRoom

- **Engineering Highlights**:

### Project 4: Channel-X
